# Quizzly.ai

> > An interactive quiz platform covering entertainment, culture, science, and lifestyle topics with structured difficulty levels.

Quizzly.ai offers curated quiz collections spanning film analysis (Cannes, surrealist cinema), music history, global cuisines, personal finance, true crime, and pop culture including Disney and Pixar. Most quizzes are organized into Level 1 topic collections for progressive learning.

## Key Topics

- Quiz platform
- Level 1 collections
- Film analysis (Cannes, Palme d'Or, Parasite)
- Surrealist cinema (Luis Buñuel, Salvador Dalí)
- Disney & Pixar
- Global cuisines & cooking
- Music trivia through decades
- True crime & forensics
- Marxist critique & ideology
- Personal finance literacy
- Weather & climate
- Construction technology
- Tech & internet culture
- Party & event games

## Entertainment & Pop Culture Quizzes

- [Disney & Pixar Quizzes (Level 1)](https://quizzly.ai/play/topic/disney-and-pixar): Level 1 Disney & Pixar animation, princesses & theme parks quizzes
- [Music Hits Through the Decades Quizzes (Level 1)](https://quizzly.ai/play/topic/music-hits-through-the-decades): Level 1 music history quiz covering decades of pop culture hits
- [British Music Quizzes (Level 1)](https://quizzly.ai/play/topic/british-music): Level 1 UK music history & British music trivia quiz collection
- [Tech & Internet Culture Quizzes (Level 1)](https://quizzly.ai/play/topic/tech-and-internet-culture): Level 1 quizzes on social media, memes, & online privacy basics

## Film & Cinema Analysis

- [Cannes Palm d'Or Winners](https://quizzly.ai/play/cannes-palm-dor-winners): Quiz on Cannes Film Festival Palme d'Or winning films like Parasite
- [Surrealist Cinema](https://quizzly.ai/play/surrealist-cinema): Quiz on surrealist films by Luis Buñuel & Salvador Dalí
- [Ethnographic Film](https://quizzly.ai/play/ethnographic-film): Documentary genre quiz exploring cultural representation & anthropology
- [Show Creators & Writers](https://quizzly.ai/play/show-creators-and-writers): Quiz on television & film creators, writers & screenwriting
- [Marxist & Ideology Critique](https://quizzly.ai/play/marxist-and-ideology-critique): Quiz on Marxist ideology critique analyzing capitalism & cultural criticism

## Food & Culinary Quizzes

- [Food & Global Flavors Quizzes (Level 1)](https://quizzly.ai/play/topic/food-and-global-flavors): Level 1 international cuisines & cooking basics quiz collection
- [Food Explorer: Identify the World's Tastiest Dishes! (Level 1)](https://quizzly.ai/play/topic/food-explorer-identify-the-worlds-tastiest-dishes): Level 1 global cuisines & world dishes identification quiz collection
- [American Food & Culinary History Quizzes (Level 1)](https://quizzly.ai/play/topic/american-food-and-culinary-history): Level 1 American cuisine & culinary history quiz collection

## Lifestyle & Personal Development

- [Money & Personal Finance Quizzes (Level 1)](https://quizzly.ai/play/topic/money-and-personal-finance): Level 1 financial literacy, budgeting & banking basics quizzes
- [True Crime & Mystery Stories Quizzes (Level 1)](https://quizzly.ai/play/topic/true-crime-and-mystery-stories): Level 1 true crime, forensics & law enforcement mystery quizzes
- [Baby Shower & Wedding Party Games Quizzes (Level 1)](https://quizzly.ai/play/topic/baby-shower-and-wedding-party-games): Level 1 baby shower & wedding party trivia game collection
- [Hen, Stag & Party Nights Quizzes (Level 1)](https://quizzly.ai/play/topic/hen-stag-and-party-nights): Level 1 bachelor/bachelorette party & nightlife trivia games

## Science & Technology

- [Pioneers of Science & Lost Works](https://quizzly.ai/play/pioneers-of-science-and-lost-works): Quiz on scientific pioneers like Archimedes, Galileo & lost works
- [Construction Technology Quizzes (Level 1)](https://quizzly.ai/play/topic/construction-technology): Level 1 quizzes on building systems & sustainable construction methods
- [Weather, Climate & Disasters Quizzes (Level 1)](https://quizzly.ai/play/topic/weather-climate-and-disasters): Level 1 meteorology, climate change & weather instruments quizzes
- [Natural World](https://quizzly.ai/play/natural-world): Quiz on biodiversity, ecosystems & environmental education
